name: Vita Grande
overview: Vita Grande standing tall at 250 feet is an epitome of elevated privileges. This 19 storey marvel developed by Meteora Developers is set to redefine the skyline of Jumeirah Village Circle Dubai. Vita Grande isn't merely a residential building but a vibrant community that tells of an epic triad of stories those of its predecessors The East Crest and 7 Park Central, and its own. The project which promises boutique living spaces with spacious 1 bedroom layouts, is under construction and scheduled for handover by the 1st quarter of 2025.
